1) 在采集机上手工 curl -sv \u003c目标URL\u003e 复现: 1) Reproduce it on the collector host with curl -sv <target URL> and separate a connection failure, a timeout and an unexpected status code; 2) For a connection failure, first confirm the target port is reachable and the process is alive; 3) For an unexpected status code, check the target service logs; 4) Verify the probe's timeout, expected status code and certificate verification match reality so the config itself is not causing the alert.
1) 用 echo | openssl s_client -connect \u: 1) Run echo | openssl s_client -connect <domain>:443 -servername <domain> 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates to confirm the expiry date and the issuing chain; 2) If you use ACME/certbot, check the renewal timer and its last run log, and confirm the service was reloaded after renewal; 3) For manually issued certificates, contact the issuer immediately and deploy the new one; 4) After deployment re-run the same openssl command to verify, and confirm every node (including CDN and load balancers) has been updated.
HTTP 探测返回非 0 结果码，目标服务不可达或返回了非预期状态，用户侧可能已: The HTTP probe returned a non-zero result code: the target service is unreachable or returned an unexpected status, and users may already be seeing failures.
HTTPS 证书将在 7 天内过期。证书过期后浏览器与客户端会直接拒绝连接，属于: The HTTPS certificate expires within 7 days. Once expired, browsers and clients refuse the connection outright — a completely avoidable self-inflicted outage.
